section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. This comparison was run at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 4. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 173 | 600 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Side effects | 184 | 600 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 168 | 600 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Side effects | 116 | 600 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
